description: Impact classifier on 24 notes NOT in the dataset, written to probe phrasing the supplied notes do not use. Same author as the rules, so this is a robustness probe, not an unbiased accuracy estimate.

errors.note: Toll charges on the expressway were hiked, adding to trip costs for all carriers.
Diesel became cheaper this month as global crude prices fell.
The new GST e-way bill rule caused paperwork delays but rates did not change.
Carriers absorbed the higher toll without passing it on to shippers.
Transporters reduced rates to win back volume.
There was no increase in freight rates after the policy change.

frozen_note: First-pass result of the cue lexicon on the held-out notes, recorded BEFORE the lexicon was revised in response to these errors. This is the only genuinely held-out number.
